title: SCFSim: A Python framework for agent-based simulation of credit risk propagation in supply chain finance networks
description: SCFSim simulates credit risk propagation in multi-tier supply chain finance networks. It couples four switchable contagion channels (counterparty losses, supply disruption, demand contraction, bank credit crunch) with an endogenous receivables-financing backstop whose frictions - visibility depth, verification haircut and fraud rate - are first-class scenario parameters, so that blockchain-enabled deep-tier financing can be studied as a controlled counterfactual. Includes graph-theoretic verification benchmarks, sweep and ablation utilities, and a reproducible example suite.
